title: The Deadly Wave of Syrup
description: Boston, 1919: a giant tank burst and sent a wave of molasses through the streets.

scenes.narration: In 1919, a wave of sticky syrup killed twenty-one people in Boston.
scenes.image_prompt: dark brown wave of molasses sweeping through a 1919 city street, buildings

scenes.narration: It's January 15th, 1919. A giant tank holds over eight million litres of molasses.
scenes.image_prompt: huge steel storage tank next to a harbour in 1919 Boston, workers

scenes.narration: Just after noon, the tank bursts with a sound like gunfire.
scenes.image_prompt: steel tank bursting open with rivets flying, 1919, dramatic moment

scenes.narration: A wave of molasses, several metres high, rushes through the streets.
scenes.image_prompt: tall wave of molasses crashing through a neighbourhood street, people running

scenes.narration: It crushes buildings and damages the elevated railway.
scenes.image_prompt: damaged elevated railway structure and crushed wooden buildings covered in molasses

scenes.narration: People and horses are trapped. Rescuers wade through waist-deep syrup.
scenes.image_prompt: 1919 rescuers wading through thick brown molasses pulling people out

scenes.narration: The clean-up takes weeks. Locals said the harbour stayed brown for months.
scenes.image_prompt: workers hosing down brown streets near a harbour, 1919

scenes.narration: Some locals claimed the area smelled sweet on hot days for decades. Strangest disaster you know? Comment below.
scenes.image_prompt: quiet Boston waterfront street on a hot summer day, 1920s
